# One command per line; pushing a change to this file runs them on Modal via GitHub Actions.
# run 16b: stage 2 + stage 4 for the AZURE control only, from its run 16a stills recomposed on CPU with stage 1b QA 0.10.1
# (no engine is run again). The jobs Volume keeps /<job_id>/stage1b/ from run 16a; a fresh export gives the same job id
# (azure-palm-baby-doll-dress-de3bc1eeb3e0, checked in review), so --recompose-dress re-makes the stills from run 16a's raw
# FASHN outputs with the 0.10.1 composite and QA. --dress-expect pins the reviewed pixels: if the recomposed still's pixel
# sha256 (decoded RGB, not the PNG file; identical with numpy 2.2.6 as in the Modal image) differs, the run stops before
# stage 2. A changed job id or a record for other inputs also stops it before any GPU time.
# 0.10.1 vs run 16a: azure's grey shoulder caps covered with the garment's own pixels (0 px of mannequin left beside the cloth);
# the azure stills are pixel-identical to the 0.10.0 replay the reviewer checked.
# Cost estimate (GPU list price, not the invoice): stage 2 + stage 4 about $1.60-1.68 (run 15's per-product cost minus its
# $0.03-0.07 of stage 1b); the CPU recompose well under a cent. About $1.6-1.7 in all, at most about $1.75.
# Before reading stage 2: check stage1b/record.json "recomposed" and summary.usable_for_stage2, and that the log printed
# "still pixel sha256: d4cbc556b400eeb9..." (front) and "695c51459ff080c9..." (back).
pnpm build:packages
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike shop:bohohippychic -- --fetch-images
git diff --exit-code -- spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/images.json spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/products.json
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product azure-palm-baby-doll-dress
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/azure-palm-baby-doll-dress --recompose-dress --dress-pin front=fashn,back=fashn --dress-expect front=d4cbc556b400eeb9c145f9c1,back=695c51459ff080c9657cdfbd --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::azure-palm-baby-doll-dress: run 16b failed"
# Held back, only after the founder signs off in writing on Qwen's invented pocket flap (left hip) and darker print
# (unnormalised median dE 10.4 front / 7.4 back against the shop photo, azure 4.3 / 2.5). The 0.10.1 stills pass, with no grey
# left at the crotch (0 / 0 px); with sign-off it is one more line, about +$1.6-1.7:
#   pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product rosewater-palazzo-pants

#   woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi: Qwen front grey shoulder slope (255 px); Qwen back sleeve colours swapped, drawn too big; FASHN front cropped.
